### Gideon and the Fleece
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gideon-and-fleece
Passage: Judges 6:39
Points:
- Gideon's request for signs revealed hesitant faith despite God's previous deliverances.
- God graciously condescended to meet Gideon's doubts rather than rebuking him.
- Believers should not expect extra-biblical signs as a standard pattern today.
- God guides Christians through the wisdom and principles given in Scripture.
- Believers are free to make choices that align with God's Word without fearing they missed His will.

### The Voice of Circumstance
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-devotional-02-or-18-or-03-1239693.html
Passage: Judges 6:36-37
Points:
- God can speak to believers through everyday circumstances to confirm His direction.
- Gideon's fleece serves as an example of seeking confirmation through external circumstances.
- God also uses people, such as pastors and friends, to speak into our situations.
- Major decisions should not be based solely on circumstantial signs.
- Whatever guidance God gives through circumstances will never contradict Scripture.
